This time, we will introduce a new batch of weapons and special devices! What they exactly are will be revealed in the near future when the update lands… Here’s a small sneak peek.

notes.title: Update (Mar 12, 2024): New Music, Boost to Plasma Projectiles & Bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Extended the lifetime of plasma projectiles after they bounce off surfaces.
[*] Changed music for Arena Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where player could talk with non-existent entity in the Cyonpolis Arena.
[*] Fixed a bug that erroneously awarded achievements for completing a level if the player died simultaneously with the last NPC.
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch involving a solitary white pixel visible in a single frame of the NPC soldier's gunpowder pistol animation sequence.
[*] Optimized audio effect file loading to occur in the background, enhancing performance on lower-end machines.
[/list]

notes.title: Update (Dec 2, 2023): Camera rotation
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8-lobIyilO4;full][/previewyoutube]
You can now rotate the camera freely and lock it to any position.

Keyboard:

[b][1][/b] to rotate left
[b][2][/b] to reset rotation
[b][3][/b] to rotate right

Gamepad (XBOX controller example):

[b][directional pad left][/b] to rotate left
[b][directional pad right][/b] to rotate right
[b][X][/b] to reset rotation

notes.title: THE AGE OF REDGAR IS UPON US!
notes.content:
Gather 'round, everyone, raise your pints and seize your axes, for the era of Redgar has arrived! 🪓🍻🚀

Take command of Redgar, the village chief's son, who may not initially have the knack but can certainly grow into the role. No one is born a leader, but you can evolve into one.

Explore shadowy dungeons, sketchy bars, bustling villages, and gruesome arenas. The world is your oyster, though whether Vikings actually eat oysters is up for debate. But don't let your mind wander; a moment's distraction from swinging that axe might cost you dearly, as one blow means curtains.

[b]For a limited time, enjoy a whopping 20% off![/b]

notes.title: 2 WEEKS TO LAUNCH
notes.content:
Our excitement is at its peak as we draw closer to the game's launch in just two weeks. The culmination of tireless dedication and creativity is about to become a reality, and the anticipation is electrifying.

Redgar: The Space Viking is an exhilarating adventure filled with a vast array of medieval and sci-fi weaponry. Delve into intricately designed settings within ominous spaceships and dungeons, where you can opt for a stealthy, covert approach or go guns blazing. It also has an electrifying soundtrack, immersing you fully in the experience. 

We get it, a killer storyline is just meh without a truly formidable villain. So here’s a sneak peak of the Big Bad Evil Guy, the true cosmic ruler (pending approval), and quite possibly the ultimate boss who cares zilch about working conditions but would make a wild episode of Undercover Boss - meet StratosX.

Resist and die - or win and etch your legend into the fabric of the cosmos. That’s it. That’s your challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958732/c0668200c9dce915c5d260275cdb7cc50f82729e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Playtest of Redgar: The Space Viking
notes.content:
Long before Hotline Miami was invented, Vikings invented space travel, cause that's where the cool stuff happens.

Redgar: The Space Viking is a story-driven top-down shooter in a retro-futuristic world combining dark medieval times with science fiction. You play as a young, and reckless space Viking Redgar. You must save his family from the evil regime that is taking over the world with the help of mighty old gods. Be Redgar, the legendary space Viking hero, and join playtest now.

Be Redgar, the legendary space Viking hero, and join playtest now.: [url=https://www.bonusstage.co/join-playtest/redgar]https://www.bonusstage.co/join-playtest/redgar[/url]

We keep the form open until June 21st. Steam keys with instructions will be sent on June 22nd to all participants.
